scope: Adopted NFL on-field playing-rule amendments, expiry of temporary playing rules, and explicitly classified football competition-format changes. League bylaws/transaction resolutions are separate and not part of this on-field registry.
critical_limitations: 2010-2013 and 2015 are reconstructed from contemporaneous adopted-rule reporting and official NFL safety chronology; original year-specific final rulebook amendment matrices and every supplemental in-season ruling have not all been checked.

2014 and 2016-2026 entries are anchored to published NFL rulebook change tables or approved-proposal listings. Full line-by-line edition diffs and later in-season interpretations are not proved complete.
2019 permanent replay/2020 transition may be described in both enactment and permanency/expiry records; count registry records, not unique legal amendments.
2026 work-stoppage replay rule is a contingent approval, NOT an unconditionally activated on-field rule.
Official rules sometimes use changed section numbering across years; exact old-text/new-text paragraphs must be extracted before automated legality enforcement.

Rulebook PDFs indexed by search were not all available for direct page-by-page retrieval during this audit. Links should be revalidated and document hashes pinned before claiming completed full-document verification.
Proposals voted down, tabled, or withdrawn are not treated as adopted.

implementation_contract.historical_sampling: Each historical event retains source_rule_ids; target simulated event uses target_rule_ids and must pass source/target regime compatibility check.
implementation_contract.activation: Do not consider an approved-contingent provision active without documented activation.
implementation_contract.effective_coverage: A record beginning in a season does not imply perpetual unchanged effect: resolve supersession/expiries by explicit changes.
implementation_contract.data_policy: No source-year legality translation without rule-aware tests and explicit return/scoring/clock/possession reconciliation.
